ambush.oromist-npc.mining: Something moves in the tunnels... orcs!
command.oromist-npc.ambush_failed: Could not find a valid place for the ambush.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.0: Fresh meat. So you are %1$s... soon you will be nobody.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.1: I smell a human. And it smells of fear.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.2: Your head will look good on my spike, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.4: Remember my name. It'll be the last thing you hear.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.5: A human. We crossed the Farlands looking for prey like you, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.6: Beyond the edge of the world there are no humans left. That's why we came here.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.7: I smell a human! Tonight there'll be meat on the fire.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.8: The only good things in this world are war and meat. And you bring both, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.9: My warchief pays well for a human head.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.0: The wound you gave me in %3$s still hurts, %1$s. Today I pay it back.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.1: %2$s days ago you cut me open. Now it's my turn.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.2: This scar has your name on it, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.3: You marked me in %3$s. Orcs collect scars... and revenge.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.4: One more wound. One more reason to hunt you, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.0: Yes, I ran in %3$s. A smart orc knows when to retreat... and when to return.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.1: Last time I escaped. This time there's nothing to run from.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.2: Did you laugh when I ran, %1$s? Laugh now.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.3: I retreated to sharpen my axe. It's sharp now.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.4: Beyond the Farlands we learned to wait. Today the wait is over.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.0: Look who's back! Last time you ran away in %3$s, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.1: Running again, coward? You've done it %4$s times already.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.2: Your legs were faster than your sword %2$s days ago.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.3: Running again, human? That's how prey runs.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.4: I followed your trail from %3$s. Humans smell of fear.
You killed my brothers in %3$s. I've come to collect.
I saw you slaughter my kin, %1$s. I don't forget.
Every orc you killed screams in my head. Today they'll be quiet.
My war-brother fell by your hand. For every orc you kill, ten cross the Farlands.
The drums mourn the ones you killed, %1$s. And they ask for your blood.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.0: We meet again, %1$s. I always find you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.1: You can't hide from me. Never.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.3: An orc never loses the trail of its prey.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.0: You again? I killed you in %3$s %2$s days ago, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.1: I've tasted your blood once. I want more.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.2: The worm I killed in %3$s came crawling back!
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.3: Your death made me a captain. What will you give me this time?
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.4: Your flesh fed my tribe in %3$s, %1$s. Back for a rematch?
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.5: Since I killed you, the shamans sing my name.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player_again: I've killed you %4$s times, %1$s. Don't you learn?
I lost count... oh wait: %4$s. Let's go for another!
I've killed you %4$s times. The shamans say your spirit is stubborn.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.0: Thought you killed me in %3$s? Look at this scar, %1$s!
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.1: Death didn't want me. I came back for you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.2: You left me for dead %2$s days ago. Mistake.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.3: Surprise, %1$s! Orcs don't die that easily.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.4: The shamans stitched my skin with sinew. I came back from the dead for you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.5: Death spat me back out. Not even she wants orcs, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death_agai: You've 'killed' me %4$s times. I'm still here.
Going to try killing me again? You know how this ends.
Dead %4$s times, back %4$s times. War won't let me rest.
dialogue.oromist-npc.taunt_kill.5: For the lands beyond the Farlands!
dialogue.oromist-npc.fleeing.3: I'll come back with the whole horde!
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.0: I'm a captain now, thanks to you!
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.2: The army will know my name.
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.3: Now I'm in command! Sound the war drums!
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.4: My name will be sung beyond the Farlands!
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.0: Nice house, %1$s. It'll look better on fire.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.1: We followed you to your burrow.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.4: Your wall won't stop the horde.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.5: Smells like bread... and human. Human is better!
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.1: Down here nobody will hear you scream.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.3: The tunnels led us right to you, worm.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.4: Underground, a human has nowhere to run.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_travel.3: Our scouts spotted you from the hill.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_travel.4: This road is orc territory now.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_travel.5: The horde marches. And you're in the way.
dialogue.oromist-npc.dying.5: Beyond the... Farlands... they wait for me...
dialogue.oromist-npc.dying.6: Let the shamans... sing my name...
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.10: The lands beyond the Farlands ran out of humans. You're next, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.11: My shaman read your death in a pig's bones. He's never wrong.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.12: Humans build walls. Orcs build wars.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.13: My dead mount is hungry, %1$s. So am I.
dialogue.oromist-npc.first_meeting.14: Hear the drums? They beat every time we find a human.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.5: The shaman seared your wound with green fire. It still burns, %1$s... and so do I.
dialogue.oromist-npc.wounded_by_player.6: You wounded me in %3$s. Since then I only eat raw meat, to remember the taste of revenge.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.5: I fled in %3$s, but only because my dead horse stumbled. Today it won't.
dialogue.oromist-npc.fled_from_player.6: An orc who flees lives for another war. And war is all that matters.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.5: Run, human! That's how your kind ran when we crossed the Farlands.
dialogue.oromist-npc.player_fled.6: My riders ride beasts that never tire, because they're already dead. You can't run, %1$s.
You killed my kin in %3$s. Tonight the shaman will work magic with their bones... and with yours.
A fallen orc becomes a war song. You'll just be crow food.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.4: Humans leave a trail: smoke, bread and fear. Easy to follow.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambushed_player.5: My riders smelled you from across the valley.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.6: %2$s days ago I hung your helmet in the warchief's tent. I came for the rest.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player.7: I killed you in %3$s and we feasted for three days. War with you tastes good, %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.killed_player_again: %4$s deaths, %1$s. My clan already sings songs about you... songs to laugh at.
Every time I kill you, the warchief gives me the best meat of the feast.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.6: Not even the Farlands could kill me, %1$s. Did you think you could?
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death.7: The shaman pulled me back with a blood spell. I owe him a head: yours.
dialogue.oromist-npc.survived_death_agai: I die, I return, I die, I return. For an orc, the war never ends.
dialogue.oromist-npc.taunt_kill.8: Tonight we eat roast human with potatoes!
dialogue.oromist-npc.taunt_kill.9: Beat the drums! One less in this soft world!
dialogue.oromist-npc.fleeing.5: It's only a tactical retreat! The war goes on!
dialogue.oromist-npc.fleeing.6: Shaman! I need your magic, now!
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.5: Tonight they'll paint my face with human blood, as tradition demands.
dialogue.oromist-npc.promoted.6: They'll give me my own war beast! A dead horse that knows no fear!
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.6: We only grow potatoes to go with the meat. Your garden will be ours, and you, the meat.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_home.7: Your stone walls didn't stop the Farlands. They won't stop me either.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.5: We come from caves deeper than this, beyond the edge of the world.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_mining.6: The shaman says stone remembers blood. Here it will remember yours.
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_travel.6: Riders, surround it! Don't let it escape!
dialogue.oromist-npc.ambush_travel.7: Every road in this world ends at the horde.
dialogue.oromist-npc.dying.7: The shaman... will bring... my spirit... back...
intel.oromist-npc.hint: It's badly wounded: sneak and right-click to interrogate it.
announce.oromist-npc.shaman_ritual: Chanting rises among the trees... the shaman drags away the body of %1$s.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_lost.0: My mount! What did you do to my mount, %1$s?
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_lost.1: It was already dead, human. And you killed it again!
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_lost.2: Now I hunt you on foot. Slower... and more painful.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_lost.3: That beast crossed the Farlands with me. You won't cross this day.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_lost.4: Get off your horse too, %1$s! Oh, you have none. Good.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_killed.0: You killed my mount in %3$s, %2$s days ago. Today I mount your head on a stake.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_killed.1: Remember my horse, %1$s? I do. Every night.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_killed.2: I had to walk back from %3$s. Every step, I thought of you.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_killed.3: You can't kill a dead horse twice... yet you managed it.
dialogue.oromist-npc.mount_killed.4: The shamans gave me another beast. Nobody will give you another life.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogated.0: You made me talk, %1$s. Now I'll make you scream.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogated.1: Because of you the whole Horde calls me a snitch. That is paid in blood.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogated.2: %2$s days ago you tore a secret out of me. Today I tear your head off.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogated.3: In %3$s you made me betray my own. Never again.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogated.4: The other orcs laugh at me. When you're dead, they'll stop laughing.
Enough, enough! I'll tell you... just let me go!
Don't kill me, human. I know things... things about the captains.
If they learn I talked, they'll eat me. If I don't, you kill me. Fine...
Listen, listen, %1$s. There's one everybody fears... but he has a weak spot.
The shaman said it, not me! I only repeat what I heard by the fire.
dialogue.oromist-npc.interrogation_refus: Talk? A captain doesn't betray the Horde. Finish what you started.
Kill me. The shamans will bring me back, and I still won't tell you anything.
You think pain scares me? I was born beyond the edge of the world.
Ask my axe. It has something to tell you.
horde.oromist-npc.title: What the Bones Say
horde.oromist-npc.empty: The bones are silent: no orc knows you yet.
horde.oromist-npc.help.0: ☠ is your nemesis: the orc that hates you most.
horde.oromist-npc.help.2: interrogating a wounded orc or reading war notes.
horde.oromist-npc.help.3: Click an orc to see everything it remembers.
